title: Mimas rules
description: Match-wide rules (rules.json): the damage lanes, the stats and abilities every hero has before gear, and the modifiers that apply to every attack.

damageTypes.description: The damage lanes. Changing this list means updating the enums in item.schema.json and ability.schema.json too.

elements.description: The elements an attack may carry and a modifier may condition on (design: #elements). Changing this list means updating the enums in ability.schema.json, modifier.schema.json and boon.schema.json too.

bestOf.description: Maximum rounds; odd. First to bestOf / 2 + 1 wins.

draft.description: The draft between rounds (design: #draft): offer counts per role and the host's timer.

winner.description: Offers for the player who won the previous round.

loser.description: Offers for the player who lost the previous round.

timeoutMs.description: How long the host waits before it submits a timeout pick (offer 0). Core never reads a clock.

boons.description: The floors boons are held to (design: #stats rule 3, #enchant).

hp.description: A unit's maximum hit points never drop below this.

ap.description: A unit's action points per turn never drop below this.

minCost.description: An ability's cost never drops below this through overrides. Nothing is ever free.

globalModifiers.description: Modifier ids evaluated for every attack (high ground is the shipped example).

heights.description: Converts a map's integer height levels into the body units sight and trajectories are measured in (design: #board, #line-of-sight).

unitsPerLevel.description: Height units one map level is worth.

body.description: A hero's body height in units above the tile top; this is what blocks a shot.

aim.description: Where attacks leave from and land, in units above the tile top. 1..body.

baseStats.description: The numbers every hero starts with before gear. hp and ap are required; no value may be negative.

innateAbilities.description: Ability ids every hero has whatever it wears. At least one must be a movement ability; no item may grant one of these.

clock.description: The one clock M2 ships (design: #time-controls, #online). Rules, not balance: the server times the turn and the client draws its rope from the same numbers.

turnMs.description: Turn deadline in milliseconds, for every turn of every player.

lagGraceMs.description: Cap on the measured round-trip allowance the server adds before it ends a turn, so a command sent before the deadline is never refused.

reconnectGraceMs.description: How long a disconnected seat is kept before the server forfeits it.
